summary: Tested Briefing Evento feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass covering auth gating, live briefing structure, hospitality cost redaction, publish/list/get/delete versions, version numbering, stale detection after data mutation, and no-duplication invariant (live shifts count equals /api/shifts count). Frontend: /eventi/:id/briefing loads with BOZZA LIVE badge, completeness panel (62%), all 7 sections (teams, staff, shifts, maps, hospitality, sponsors, timeline), publish dialog flow works and clears stale banner, versions dialog lists snapshots, Visualizza opens read-only snapshot with viewing-version-banner and back-to-live returns to draft, presentation mode prev/next/close works, Esporta PDF calls window.print. Found ONE real UX bug: nested AlertDialog inside the versions Dialog cannot be confirmed because the parent Dialog overlay (z-[100]) covers the AlertDialog content/action (z-50), preventing users from deleting a published version from the Storico dialog.

ui_bugs.issue: AlertDialog for delete confirmation opens INSIDE the parent Dialog. Dialog overlay uses z-[100] while AlertDialog overlay/content use z-50, so the Dialog overlay intercepts pointer events and the 'Elimina' confirm button cannot be clicked. Users cannot delete a published version from the Storico dialog.

action_items: Fix z-index conflict: raise AlertDialogOverlay/AlertDialogContent above z-[100] (e.g. z-[110]/z-[120]) in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/alert-dialog.jsx, OR replace nested AlertDialog inside versions Dialog with a confirm-in-place pattern / close the parent Dialog before opening the AlertDialog.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2278 lines — consider splitting (routers per resource).
briefing_versions cleanup on event deletion: verify cascade (OPERATIONAL list includes briefing_versions for admin reset, but per-event delete flow should also clean up briefing_versions).
AlertDialog z-index (z-50) is lower than Dialog (z-[100]) in the shadcn setup — any nested AlertDialog inside a Dialog is unusable. Global fix recommended.

rca of the issue: Version deletion bug RCA: In /app/frontend/src/components/ui/dialog.jsx, DialogOverlay uses z-[100]; in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/alert-dialog.jsx, AlertDialogOverlay and AlertDialogContent use z-50. When AlertDialog is rendered inside an open Dialog (versions Storico dialog contains AlertDialog per version row), the Dialog's overlay is painted above the AlertDialog. Playwright confirmed: DialogOverlay intercepts pointer events on 'Elimina' button. Mitigation: bump alert-dialog overlay/content to z-[110] and z-[110], or close parent Dialog before showing delete confirmation, or use inline confirm.
